recommendations.text: Monitor rainfall and ensure the irrigation system is functioning well to maximize the benefits of the additional rainfall for the cowpeas crop.
Keep an eye on market trends and sell the cowpeas at the current price of 0.635 USD/kg for steady income.

Be vigilant and take preventive measures to protect the cowpeas from potential pest infestations, especially considering the high severity of fall armyworm and medium severity of cutworm affecting sorghum in the district.
Plan for future crops, especially considering the ongoing pest issues, and early planting of short-maturing crops like cowpeas can help mitigate the risks.
